name: Knowledge relations
summary: Judge whether two stated facts or entities hold a claimed relation.

input.state: The two items and the relation claimed between them.

holds.instructions: The claimed relation between the two items holds as stated.
holds.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

criteria.unrelated: The items hold no listed relation.

uncertainty.abstain: an unverifiable claim answers not-held - the graph records only supported edges
uncertainty.refusal: a refused pair reports refused and the edge is queued for review

limits: Judges the stated claim, not world truth - the caller's sources carry the evidence.
Edge suggestion only; graph writes belong to the caller's curation step.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
